title: Episode 105 Closes and Bhai Taru Singh Enters the Narrative

blocks.text: Rattan Singh closes the previous sakhi by saying he has written it as he heard it from his father, then turns the reader toward a new narrative movement. The page is a hinge rather than a single scene, because it deliberately finishes the earlier account before announcing a fresh episode.

Episode 106 opens with Bhai Taru Singh, presented as a fearless martyr from the Majha village of Poolha whose scalp could be taken from his head but whose faith could not be taken from his heart. He is introduced as a disciplined, truthful, and devout Singh whose steadfastness will condemn the oppressor rather than save his own life.

The page also frames the political problem that drives the episode: the Lahore nawab cannot understand how the scattered Singhs continue to live when they hold no offices, pursue no ordinary trade, and are hunted on every road. That question leads directly into the search for the hidden networks that keep the Khalsa alive.
